name: error_thrashing
description: The worker produces new semantic content but repeatedly fails with the same error fingerprint. Two identical failure fingerprints in ten minutes trigger a suspicion signal and an early watchdog check.
original_prompt: Refactor the run manager to close owned sessions on shutdown.
